summary: Advance your project management skills with our PMP training.Prepare for the certification exam and learn best practices from industry professionals.
lede: Project management certification training prepares project associates and leaders to plan and deliver complex projects and study for the PMP exam. The workshop develops practical skills in team leadership, project scope and schedule planning, risk assessment, communication, and stakeholder engagement. It also covers managing project changes, reviewing compliance requirements, and evaluating project benefits, alongside lessons review and mock exam questions.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals eager to elevate their project management expertise. This course is designed for: Ambitious project associates and leaders from all industries who are looking to lead more complex projects. Anyone wishing to consolidate and solidify their project management training for career success. Individuals preparing to sit for the PMP® exam.
modules: Day 1 Introducing PMI® and Project Management
Day 2 Creating a High Performance Team
Day 4 Keep the Team on Track
Day 5 Keeping the Business in Mind
prerequisites: The necessary pre-requisite Contact Hours and training to sit for PMI®’s PMP® exam.
